# Tests the outcome ratchet in ci.yml leaves alone (#1786).
#
# One test id glob per line, as `scripts/test_outcome_record.py` names a
# test: `<classname>::<name>`, for example
# `tests.test_store.TestOpen::test_readonly[a]`. A test listed here may be
# skipped, xfailed or never executed without the diff calling it a ratchet
# violation. Say why on a `#` line above each entry; a comment after the
# glob on the same line becomes part of the glob, which then matches nothing.
